description: The Fingal SuDS Register lists sustainable urban drainage systems completed in Fingal County Council's administrative area, with location and description for each installation as shown on final drainage drawings for planning permissions granted by the council, with 2022 named as the reference year. Installations include attenuation tanks, permeable paving, detention ponds, swales, green roofs, infiltration trenches and soakaways and filter drains. Fingal County Council publishes it on its ArcGIS open data hub, and the Smart Dublin portal harvested it in February 2025. Coverage is Fingal in north County Dublin, Ireland. Format and access: downloads and services from Fingal Open Data. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: it holds SuDS tied to planning applications, not all drainage assets, and the update cycle is not stated. It is a rare public register of green-blue drainage assets for pluvial flood and adaptation studies. Related catalogue records are the BGS Infiltration SuDS Map and the susdrain SuDS case studies.
